title: NFL suspends Dre Greenlaw one game after head-butting incident in 49ers' win over Seahawks

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL suspends Dre Greenlaw one game after head-butting incident in 49ers' win over Seahawks
sources.description: The discipline stems from a second-quarter incident where the linebacker drew a late-hit flag on Sam Darnold and headbutted a helmetless Ernest Jones IV
